about: Made by tools/art-import/import_art.py. Do not edit by hand; re-run the script.
frameFormat: [page, x, y, w, h, trimX, trimY, fullW, fullH]

floor-big.note: floor tile, exactly 80 x 80 px; anchorPx = top-left corner of the cell

floor-quad.note: floor tile, exactly 80 x 80 px; anchorPx = top-left corner of the cell

floor-worn.note: floor tile, exactly 80 x 80 px; anchorPx = top-left corner of the cell

wall-face.note: the outer top wall: one per '#' cell in the top row (tiles left to right); anchorPx = the cell's top-left corner

wall-block.note: any other '#' cell (side and bottom walls, inner walls): a low stone block seen from above; tiles side by side; anchorPx = top-left of its cell; sort by the cell's bottom row

pillar.note: a round stone pillar for a single '#' cell inside a room (draw instead of wall-block if you like); anchorPx = bottom-centre of its cell

door-battle.note: Battle door for a 'D' slot in the top wall: frame 0 closed, frame 1 open (doors slide apart, the doorway glows). anchorPx = bottom-centre of the door cell. The icon plaque rises above the wall

icon-battle.note: the door's icon on its round medallion, on its own (for labels, the floor map or buttons)

door-challenge.note: Challenge door for a 'D' slot in the top wall: frame 0 closed, frame 1 open (doors slide apart, the doorway glows). anchorPx = bottom-centre of the door cell. The icon plaque rises above the wall

icon-challenge.note: the door's icon on its round medallion, on its own (for labels, the floor map or buttons)

door-treasure.note: Treasure door for a 'D' slot in the top wall: frame 0 closed, frame 1 open (doors slide apart, the doorway glows). anchorPx = bottom-centre of the door cell. The icon plaque rises above the wall

icon-treasure.note: the door's icon on its round medallion, on its own (for labels, the floor map or buttons)

door-rest.note: Rest door for a 'D' slot in the top wall: frame 0 closed, frame 1 open (doors slide apart, the doorway glows). anchorPx = bottom-centre of the door cell. The icon plaque rises above the wall

icon-rest.note: the door's icon on its round medallion, on its own (for labels, the floor map or buttons)

shrine.note: the rest shrine for an 'S' spot: shrine layer (still; every frame is the same) + shrine-glow layer (8-frame loop at 8 fps = 1 s, a gentle swell). The game can also pulse shrine-glow's alpha

chest-closed.note: closed chest idle loop (1 s at 12 fps): a glint slides down the gold bands. Layers bottom to top: chest, chest-glow, chest-fx

chest-open.note: opening, once (2.5 s at 12 fps), then play chest-opened. 0-11 wiggle and light in the seams (a rising sound), 12 the lid bursts open (pop / chime), 12-25 the light beam fades, 13-29 stars and sparkles rise

chest-opened.note: open chest idle loop (1 s at 12 fps): soft shimmering light and twinkles. Same size and anchor as chest-open, so it follows seamlessly

door-boss.note: Boss door (the Floor Keeper's door) for the 'D' slot of the room before the boss: frame 0 closed, frame 1 open (the doors slide apart behind the posts, the doorway glows warm). 160 px wide: the 1-tile opening in the middle and the stone frame overlapping half a wall tile on each side (draw it over those wall tiles). anchorPx = bottom-centre of the door cell. Add door-boss-glow on top while it's closed and the room is being fought

door-boss-glow.note: The boss door's glow loop (8 frames at 8 fps = 1 s): a gold halo swells around the crown medallion and light breathes along the gold frame. Same size and anchor as door-boss; draw it on top of door-boss frame 0 while the door is closed and the room is being fought. Straight alpha, see-through

icon-boss.note: the boss door's crown icon on its round medallion, on its own (like icon-battle: for labels, the floor map or buttons)
